verdict.rationale: Phoenix exposes an MCP endpoint so MCP-compatible clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) can search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations via natural-language agent interfaces, plus llms.txt/docs-md for AI consumption. However, most core workflows (tracing setup, prompt engineering, evaluation config) are still driven through UI/SDK/code rather than native NL commands within the product itself.
